title: Humanities Writing Companion: A Claude Skill for Voice-Preserving Humanities Academic Writing
description: A Claude Code / Claude Agent SDK skill for humanities scholars (history, philosophy, literature, cultural studies, art history, religious studies, classics) whose primary deliverable is a long-form argumentative text. Not a research pipeline, not a polishing tool, but an interlocutor that engages with arguments, concepts, and stylistic voice. Features four-layer critique (foundation/structure/paragraph/sentence), devil's-advocate mode with anti-sycophancy thresholds, deep-voice preservation, reflexive-writing support for human-AI co-authoring research, discipline-specific critique dimensions, ADHD-friendly interaction design, and engineering-grade infrastructure. Bilingual: SKILL.md and README in English and Chinese. Designed as a humanities-side complement to academic-research-skills (Imbad0202) for the empirical research pipeline.
